content: धारा .²1 A stream or current of water, a line of descending fluid, stream, current; धारा नैव पतन्ति चातकमुखे मेघस्य किं दूषणम् <ls>Bh. 2. 93</ls>; <ls>Me. 55</ls>; <ls>R. 16. 66</ls>; आबद्धधारमश्रु प्रावर्तत <ls>Dk. 74</ls>. .²2 A shower, a hard or sharp-driving shower. .²3 A continuous line or series; प्रणतौ हन्त निरन्तराश्रुधाराः <ls>Bv. 2. 20</ls>. .²4 A leak or hole in a pitcher. .²5 The pace of a horse; धाराः प्रसाधयितुमव्यतिकीर्णरूपाः <ls>Śi. 5. 60</ls>; <ls>N. 1. 72</ls>. .²6 The margin, edge or border of anything; ध्रुवं स नीलोत्पलपत्रधारया शमीलतां छेत्तुमृषिर्व्यवस्यति <ls>Ś. 1. 18</ls>. .²7 The sharp edge of a sword, axe, or of any cutting instrument; तर्जितः परशुधारया मम <ls>R. 11. 78</ls>, <ls n="R.">6. 42</ls>, <ls n="R.">10. 86</ls>, <ls n="R. 10.">41</ls>; <ls>Bh. 2. 28</ls>. .²8 The edge of a mountain or precipice. .²9 A wheel or the periphery of a wheel; धारानिबद्धेव कलङ्करेखा <ls>R. 13. 15</ls>. .²10 A garden-wall, fence, hedge. .²11 The van or front line of an army. .²12 The highest point, excellence. .²13 A multitude. .²14 Fame. .²15 Night. .²16 Turmeric. .²17 Likeness. .²18 The tip of the ear. .²19 Speech. .²20 Rumour, report. .²21 <ab>N.</ab> of an ancient town in Mālvā, capital of king Bhoja.
